meaning: Dongding oolong tea, a famous Taiwanese partly-fermented tea

example.hakka: 逐日暗晡正食凍頂烏龍,食了還歸身燒。
example.romanization: Tiuk-ngit am-pu zang sṳ̍t Tung-tin̂ vu-liùng, sṳ̍t-liáu hai kui-sṳn seu.
example.english: I only drink Dongding oolong in the evening; after drinking it my whole body still feels warm.

note: Dongding oolong comes from the mountains of Lugu in Nantou, Taiwan, and is a pride of Taiwanese tea culture. Hakka communities in Taiwan also grow famous teas such as Oriental Beauty (膨風茶) in Hsinchu and Miaoli.
